svg.title: STRIDE
svg.desc: stride: a line of stick-figure walkers crosses a salt flat at dusk, the first fallen, the last walking on toward the horizon. Can evolution teach a six-jointed figure to walk?

g.text: A stick figure with six motorised joints learns to walk
by evolution alone: 100 walkers, 75 generations, 18 genes
each. Genetic algorithm against PSO, DE and CMA-ES.
